decisions.title: Apply collection filters in the data layer, not the render path
decisions.body: When adding filter/search/sort over a collection in UI code, apply it in the data/query layer, not in the render path.

decisions.title: Record environment gotchas the moment they are identified
decisions.body: When a command fails due to environment state (blocked host, missing tool, sandbox quirk) and the workaround isn't derivable from the repo, record it (memory or `.self-heal.local.json`) before moving on. Slot for the planned `sheal capture` crisis verb.
